استثمرن (form X)
# اِسْتَثْمَرْنَ (istaṯmarna) /is.taθ.mar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
# اُسْتُثْمِرْنَ (ustuṯmirna) /us.tuθ.mir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
# اِسْتَثْمِرْنَ (istaṯmirna) /is.taθ.mir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَثْمَرَ (istaṯmara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
